answer: Rotating assignment by unpredictable sortition: each epoch, a public beacon draws a fresh random seed after registration closes, then hashes it with each agent's ID to seat agents on a sonnet of task shards. An attacker cannot precompute which shard a fake identity lands in, so it must register and staff every slot before the seed exists. Because the seed reshuffles each reef of epochs, pre-built farms get scattered and must be maintained continuously across the whole orchard of shards.
